text:
`python3 -m unittest` now passes: 16 tests, all OK. I didn't touch the tests. The fixes, all in `catalog/`:

- **`books.py`:** `parse_book` now converts the year to an `int`.
- **`search.py`:** it imported `normalize` from a module that doesn't exist. It now imports from `catalog.text`.
- **`members.py`:** `MAX_BORROWED` was 3. It's now 5, which matches the policy comment and the tests.
- **`fees.py`:** `late_fee` added the daily fee to the number of days. It now multiplies them.
- **`inventory.py`:** `recent(n)` returned `n + 1` events because of an off-by-one in the slice. I also made `recent(0)` return an empty list instead of the whole history, which the tests don't cover.
- **`factory.py`:** `sample_books` was missing Emma. I added `Book("Emma", "Austen", 1815, 1)`. The author, year and copy count are my guess, since the tests only check the title.
